Pixel art character model sheet for a 16-bit side-scroller game, in the style of polished modern indie pixel art (crisp pixels, limited palette, 1px dark outline, soft 2-tone shading, no anti-aliasing, no blur).

Character: "Timsah", a friendly cartoon crocodile who volunteers at a polling station committee. He stands upright on two short legs, faces right in side view, long snout with a neat row of small white teeth, one big round eye on top of the head, a row of ridge bumps down his back and a thick tail. Colours: fresh green body, darker green shading, pale cream belly. He wears a blue lanyard with a small white ID badge (no text on it). Keep the design of the attached reference sprite (same proportions, colours and features) but render it with more craft and expression.

Show 6 poses in one horizontal row, all the same size and scale, feet on the same baseline, evenly spaced, each pose clearly separated:
1) idle standing, 2) blinking, 3) walking step A, 4) walking step B, 5) holding a blue envelope forward in one hand, 6) happy jump with arms up.

Each pose about 64x64 pixels in pixel-art resolution, scaled up evenly. Plain flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF) everywhere, no ground, no shadows on the background, no text, no labels, no numbers, no frame, no watermark.

16-bit pixel art background for a side-scrolling indie game, crisp pixels, limited palette, no anti-aliasing, hand-crafted look like the best modern indie pixel art games.
